Front Mission.name: Front Mission
Front Mission.summary: Front Mission is the first main entry and the first entry overall in the Front Mission series. Front Mission is part of a serialized storyline that follows the stories of various characters and their struggles involving mecha known as wanzers.

Inuyasha - Fuuun Emaki.name: Inuyasha: Fuuun Emaki
Inuyasha - Fuuun Emaki.summary: Inuyasha: Fuuun Emaki is an Adventure game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2002.
